network_status.summary_it: L'annale ufficiale conferma l'idrometro Vibrata ad Alba Adriatica, ma la scheda storica non pubblica un valore evento-specifico per il marzo 2011 attribuibile al ponte di Corropoli. Il massimo storico del 1976 non viene riutilizzato.
network_status.summary_en: The official annal confirms the Vibrata at Alba Adriatica gauge, but its station history publishes no March 2011 event-specific value attributable to the Corropoli bridge. The 1976 historical maximum is not reused.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
